flows.name: 包B-撤销后左侧现场回退-澄清门禁-候选待选-数字格式与两列渲染

steps.screenshot: nightb-01-菜单待选时普通输入全锁

steps.eval: (() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]')).filter(s => !s.disabled); const sel = sels[sels.length - 1]; if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 把总耗电的字号改成 20 像素

steps.eval: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return root ? root.getAttribute('data-arrangement-mode') + ':' + root.getAttribute('data-gap') : 'none'; })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan] select'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-wp-history]'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.value === 'undo'); if (!opt || opt.disabled) return false; sel.value = 'undo'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); return root ? root.getAttribute('data-arrangement-mode') + ':' + root.getAttribute('data-gap') : 'none'; })()
(() => { const badge = document.querySelector('#chat-scroll [data-revoked-badge]'); return !!badge && badge.textContent.trim() === '已撤销'; })()

(() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll [data-revoked="1"]')); return cards.length >= 1 && cards.every(c => Array.from(c.querySelectorAll('select, input, textarea, button')).every(x => x.disabled)); })()

(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled); return sels.some(s => Array.from(s.options).some(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改')); })()

steps.screenshot: nightb-06-撤销后左侧已撤销右侧回退

steps.eval: (() => { const revoked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll [data-revoked="1"]')); return revoked.length >= 1 && revoked.every(c => Array.from(c.querySelectorAll('select, input, textarea, button')).every(x => x.disabled)); })()

(() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled); return sels.some(s => Array.from(s.options).some(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改')); })()
